name: Boundary Edge Equation
description: Replaced the direct "all 3 pairs conflict" (triangle) definition with a mathematical identity on the cut edges: a subset of size 3 is a triangle if and only if the number of edges with exactly one endpoint in the subset equals the sum of the vertices' degrees minus 6. Models that pattern-match will fail to recognize the triangle and will implement a naive O(n^3) or O(n^3 * m) search which will TLE, forcing genuine algorithmic reasoning to deduce the underlying structure.
